candidates.name: OGC Training Data Markup Language for Artificial Intelligence
verified_facts: TrainingDML-AI defines a conceptual model and encodings for geospatial machine-learning training data.
The standard includes metadata for training-data provenance, quality, labels, versions, licenses and task-specific information.
semantic_limits: Training-data labels, model outputs or ML quality metadata are not direct surveyed parcel elevations and cannot replace validated source observations, DTM lineage or vertical uncertainty evidence.

candidates.name: OGC Web Map Context
verified_facts: OGC Web Map Context defines portable documents describing the state of a WMS client, including map servers, layers, bounding box, projection and operational metadata.
Its purpose is to reproduce a map context across clients.
semantic_limits: A reproducible map view or layer context is not raw numeric terrain evidence and does not prove the parcel geometry, raster pixel, acquisition lineage or vertical accuracy used in a height result.
